<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/workspaces/{workspaceId}/containers"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



One row per project of the workspace — since RN-521 a project that never provisioned a container is PRESENT with `registrado: null` instead of absent, because this page is the human path to start the first one. The observed state is asked of the broker only for rows `provisioning`/`running`, and only up to a per-load budget — see `naoVerificado` on rows that were skipped, and ADR 0136 for the reasoning.
